processor: Apple M1 Pro, 8 CPU cores, 16 GiB RAM

scikit_feature.reference_notes: Use original upstream JMI/CMIM/Laplacian/FCBF. Latest fork JMI ignores adaptive coefficients; FCBF truncates scores. Original FCBF requires the mechanical NumPy keyword fix dtypes -> dtype; no mathematical changes.

baseline_manifest.notes: Prototype outside src. For Gini compare both original scikit-feature and more popular compiled scikit-learn CART stumps, using the fastest correct baseline. Original ICAP implements a maximum instead of paper sum; TraceRatio pre-prunes candidates to k. Exclude those candidates rather than copying their semantic defects.

rejected_after_screen.f_classif: Numerically correct CPU prototype lost to official scikit-learn across all four screened shapes and all tested Numba thread counts.
